title: The Patient Cart
setting: a generic grocery checkout with no signs or labels
owner_input: Someone repeatedly cuts in line and the situation resolves unexpectedly.

beats.name: recognition
beats.visual: A patient shopper waits with one item while a pushy shopper slides a full cart ahead.

beats.name: pressure
beats.visual: The pushy shopper keeps adding loose items while the waiting shopper visibly deflates.

beats.name: expectation
beats.visual: The cashier reaches for the first item as the pushy shopper smirks.

beats.name: surprising_reversal
beats.visual: The overloaded cart gently rolls backward into a self-return lane while the patient shopper's single item glides forward.

beats.name: visible_relief
beats.visual: The patient shopper and cashier exchange a relieved look while the pushy shopper calmly retrieves the cart.

beats.name: loopable_finish
beats.visual: The empty space in front matches the opening composition as another tiny item enters frame.

safety.notes: No collision, injury, public humiliation, or identifiable store.

originality.notes: Generic situation and original visual resolution.
